questions.scenario: It's your first time flying on IndiGo or Air India for a family vacation. What captures your attention?

options.text: Helping your parents lift the heavy trolley bags into the overhead bin and making sure everyone is comfortable.
Looking out the window at the ground staff waving the light batons, wondering how they coordinate all the planes.
Admiring the neat uniforms of the crew, the cabin lighting, and wondering how the seats could be made softer.
Staring at the cockpit door as you board, wondering what all the buttons do and wishing you were in the captain's chair.

questions.scenario: Your school bus ride back home is completely chaotic and noisy. What is your role?

options.text: Calming down the junior kids, offering them a sip from your water bottle, and making sure nobody is standing up.
Keeping an eye on the traffic out the window and calculating exactly what time the bus will reach your stop.
Thinking about how you would redesign the bus interiors to have better air-conditioning vents and cooler seats.
Sitting right behind the bus uncle (driver), fascinated by how he maneuvers the massive vehicle through narrow Indian roads.

questions.scenario: You are making paper planes during a free period in class. How do you approach it?

options.text: You run around picking up the thrown planes, hand them back to your friends, and organize a fun throwing competition.
You calculate the exact angle to throw it and judge the wind direction from the ceiling fan to make it fly the furthest.
You spend all your time coloring the paper, drawing cool logos on the wings, and making it look like a futuristic jet.
You build the most structurally sound plane, stand up confidently on the desk, and launch it like a true commander.

questions.scenario: An annoying aunty on the train (like Rajdhani or Shatabdi) is constantly complaining that the AC is too cold.

options.text: You politely smile, offer her your extra sweater, and ask the pantry guy to bring her a warm cup of chai.
You look at the coach's AC control panel and try to figure out the exact temperature regulation system logically.
You mentally note that Indian Railways really needs to design warmer, premium-looking blankets for passengers.
You politely but firmly speak to the TT (Ticket Checker) to negotiate a solution so everyone in the cabin is comfortable.

questions.scenario: You are playing a multiplayer video game (like BGMI, Free Fire, or Valorant) with your squad. What's your play style?

options.text: I am the medic/support player, constantly running around reviving teammates and sharing my health kits with them.
I am on the voice chat giving precise callouts, marking enemy locations on the mini-map, and directing the strategy.
I care mostly about unlocking the coolest weapon skins and making my character's outfit look incredibly stylish.
I am the squad leader making the final call on where to drop and aggressively leading the team to victory.

questions.scenario: It's the Annual Day in your school and you are part of the main organizing committee. What's your duty?

options.text: Running around backstage, fixing torn costumes at the last minute, and bringing water for nervous performers.
Sitting at the control desk with a walkie-talkie, timing exactly when the curtain opens and the spotlight hits the stage.
Decorating the main stage with beautiful floral arrangements, digital screens, and making the entrance gate look grand.
Standing next to the Principal, taking responsibility for the whole event's success, and delivering the final vote of thanks.

questions.scenario: Your family visits a massive shopping mall (like Phoenix or DLF Mall) on a crowded Sunday.

options.text: Holding the heavy shopping bags for your parents without complaining and helping a lost kid find the security guard.
Looking at the digital directory map, memorizing the layout, and finding the absolute fastest route to the food court.
Admiring the beautiful window displays of Zara or H&M and checking out the premium architecture of the mall.
Taking charge of the family group, deciding which stores to visit in what order, and keeping everyone strictly on time.

questions.scenario: You have to reach the railway station to catch a train at 6:00 AM sharp. How do you handle the morning?

options.text: You are the one waking everyone up with a smile, ensuring nobody forgets their phone charger, and keeping spirits high.
You check Google Maps for live traffic, calculate the exact buffer time needed, and track the train's live running status.
You focus on selecting the most comfortable, yet highly aesthetic 'airport-style' travel outfit for the journey.
You act as the 'captain', booking the Ola/Uber, loading all the bags in the trunk, and ensuring you leave the house on the dot.

questions.scenario: A fight breaks out between two auto-rickshaw drivers on the road, causing a massive traffic jam. What's your instinct?

options.text: Step out to gently calm down the angry drivers and help the scared passengers out of the auto safely.
Observe the gridlock and quickly figure out the exact logical sequence of which vehicles need to reverse to clear the jam.
Look at the chaotic street and imagine how a properly designed road lane and modern signal system could fix this mess.
Confidently step into the middle of the road and use hand signals to direct the traffic yourself until the police arrive.

questions.scenario: Your younger sibling is terrified of riding the giant Ferris wheel (Giant Wheel) at the local Dussehra Mela.

options.text: You hold their hand tightly, tell them comforting funny stories, and distract them with a packet of popcorn.
You explain the physics of the wheel's rotation, proving mathematically that the metal structure is balanced and safe.
You point out the beautiful, colorful neon lights of the Mela from the top to make them appreciate the awesome view.
You promise them that you are in full control, tell them to trust you, and confidently lead them into the cabin.

Cabin_Crew.title: The Sky Host (Cabin Crew / Flight Attendant)
Cabin_Crew.primary_match_text: You are highly active, deeply empathetic, and love serving people! You know how to keep a smile on your face even when there is total chaos around you.
Cabin_Crew.day_in_the_life: Welcoming passengers on board, serving hot meals 30,000 feet in the air, traveling to different countries every week, and handling medical emergencies calmly.
Cabin_Crew.alternative_match_text: Your amazing people skills and grace under pressure also make you a fantastic Hotel Manager, Event Planner, or Public Relations (PR) Executive.
Cabin_Crew.roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream (English fluency is a must). Degree: A degree is preferred, but many start with a Diploma in Aviation/Hospitality. Next Steps: Clear airline interviews (like IndiGo, Air India, or Emirates) and undergo their strict 3-month grooming and safety training.

Air_Traffic_Controller.title: The Radar Master (Air Traffic Controller - ATC)
Air_Traffic_Controller.primary_match_text: You have a highly analytical brain. You stay incredibly cool under pressure, love logic, and communicate with absolute precision. You are the invisible hero keeping the skies safe.
Air_Traffic_Controller.day_in_the_life: Sitting in the high ATC glass tower at the airport, staring at complex radar screens, talking to pilots on the radio, and guiding massive airplanes to land safely without crashing.
Air_Traffic_Controller.alternative_match_text: Your love for data, logic, and systems means you would also excel as a Data Analyst, Software Engineer, or Logistics Manager.
Air_Traffic_Controller.roadmap: 11th/12th: Science (PCM is STRICTLY Mandatory). Degree: B.Tech (Any Branch) or B.Sc with Physics/Maths. Next Steps: Crack the highly competitive AAI (Airports Authority of India) ATC Exam, followed by rigorous government training.

Aviation_Designer.title: The Flight Visionary (Aviation Interior Designer)
Aviation_Designer.primary_match_text: You are a creative soul who cares deeply about aesthetics and comfort. You believe that traveling should not just be about getting from Point A to Point B, but doing it in extreme style.
Aviation_Designer.day_in_the_life: Designing luxurious first-class cabin seats for Boeing/Airbus, selecting the ambient mood lighting for the plane, and designing the stylish uniforms worn by the airline crew.
Aviation_Designer.alternative_match_text: If not in aviation, your creative eye would make you a brilliant Industrial Designer, Interior Decorator, or Fashion Designer.
Aviation_Designer.roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream (PCM needed if going via Architecture). Degree: Bachelor of Design (B.Des) or Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch). Next Steps: Specialize in Industrial or Transportation Design from top institutes like NID or IITs.

Commercial_Pilot.title: The Sky Captain (Commercial Pilot)
Commercial_Pilot.primary_match_text: You are a natural-born leader who loves taking responsibility. You have a fascination with massive machines, trust your own quick decision-making, and command respect wherever you go.
Commercial_Pilot.day_in_the_life: Sitting in the high-tech cockpit, doing pre-flight checks, pushing the throttle to take off a 70-ton machine, talking to ATC, and taking full responsibility for 300+ lives on board.
Commercial_Pilot.alternative_match_text: Your supreme leadership and courage would also make you an incredible Defense Officer (Army/Navy), Merchant Navy Captain, or Corporate CEO.
Commercial_Pilot.roadmap: 11th/12th: Science (PCM is STRICTLY Mandatory). Next Steps: Two paths - 1) Clear NDA exam to join the Indian Air Force as a fighter pilot. 2) Join a DGCA-approved flying school (like IGRUA) to get your Commercial Pilot License (CPL). Pass strict Class 1 Medicals.
